title: Book Two · Chapter 93: Leo Reads the Funny Part
story:
One warm afternoon, Leo reads a funny story to Ronan and Jun. In the story, a boy carries a very large fish home. He tells everyone he caught it alone. At his door, his sister asks for her fishing rod back.

Leo reads the first part in a proud voice. Jun grins before the ending. Ronan looks at him and misses one line.

“Wait. What did he say?”

Leo goes back. He does not start the whole story again. He finds the line about the boy's wet shoes and reads from there.

At the last part, Leo waits for a moment. Then he reads the sister's words very quietly.

Jun laughs. Ronan laughs too, but he is still looking for the rod in the picture. It rests behind the girl's leg.

“She caught it?” Ronan asks.

“The story does not say that,” Leo says. “But the rod is hers.”

Jun points at the boy's face. “He has a problem now.”

Ronan takes the page and reads the ending himself. The words are not very difficult. Leo pauses as he reads. He changes his voice too. That makes the words funny.

“Can you do that part again?”

Leo does. This time, Ronan notices the pause. Leo waits before the sister speaks. He tries the same line. But he says it too loudly. It sounds like an angry teacher.

Jun sits up straight and folds his hands. Leo points to the empty desk. “Put the rod there,” he says to Jun. All three laugh again.

Ronan tries once more, more quietly. The little change works. Jun looks at the boy's picture and smiles before the last word.

After lunch, Ronan gives the page back. It belongs to Leo. He asks if the reading room uses funny voices every week.

“Sometimes. Sometimes we read very ordinary things.”

“Like a fish with no sister?”

“Like a notice on a door.”

Ronan nods. He still likes the room in his mind. But Leo practises at home too. Some of the jokes are Leo's own.

That evening, Ronan tells the story at supper. He does not remember every word. He uses his own short sentences. Before the sister speaks, he waits.

Dad reaches for his water. Mum looks at Ronan, ready for the ending. He says the line quietly. Dad stops with the cup halfway to his mouth.

“Her rod?”

Ronan nods. Mum starts laughing. Dad puts the cup down. Then he laughs too. No water spills on the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

laugh＝笑；pause＝停顿；voice＝声音。

## 理解问题

1. Leo为什么在读故事时停顿？
2. Ronan从朋友那里得到什么真实帮助？

## 读句子

**Leo / waits / for a moment.** Leo／等待／一会儿。
